description: This file defines the TailscaleService class responsible for managing Tailscale VPN connectivity and status checking within a macOS application. It includes methods for retrieving status, opening relevant URLs, and managing internal state related to Tailscale installation and operation.

classes.name: TailscaleService
classes.description: A singleton class managing Tailscale VPN status, installation checks, and providing interface functions to open Tailscale-related URLs and perform status updates.

methods.name: checkAppInstallation
methods.description: Checks if the Tailscale app is installed in the /Applications directory.

methods.name: fetchTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous HTTP request to fetch the current Tailscale API status data.

methods.name: checkTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Main asynchronous method that updates internal state based on Tailscale's current status, IP address, and app installation.

methods.name: openTailscaleApp
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale app via the system file URL.

methods.name: openAppStore
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale app page in the Mac App Store.
